suggestions.title: Deutschlandticket and semester ticket may overlap
suggestions.body: Your semester fee now includes the Deutschlandsemesterticket, while you also pay €63.00 a month for the Deutschlandticket. It may be worth checking whether you need both.
suggestions.rationale: The Deutschlandticket contract (€756.00 a year) and the university letter saying the semester fee includes a Deutschlandsemesterticket.

suggestions.title: Send your new enrolment certificate where it is needed
suggestions.body: Your enrolment certificate for winter semester 2026/27 is on file. The gym, your employer and the scholarship foundation each have an open task to receive one.
suggestions.rationale: Three open 'submit enrolment certificate' tasks and the certificate dated 1 Sep 2026.

suggestions.title: Update your rent transfer to €670 from November
suggestions.body: Wohnbau Musterstadt eG is raising the monthly total rent from €640.00 to €670.00 from November 2026. You may want to adjust your standing order.
suggestions.rationale: The open rent item of €670.00 from the service charge statement versus the €640.00 rental contract.

suggestions.title: Add your Musterbank current account to your contracts
suggestions.body: The bank's letter about the Girokonto Klassik fee (€4.90 to €6.90) couldn't be matched to a contract. Adding the account keeps its costs and dates in one place.
suggestions.rationale: The bank letter carries a warning that it isn't matched to any contract.

suggestions.title: Confirm the electricity meter reading was reported
suggestions.body: A task to report the meter reading at the start of supply with Stadtwerke is still open. If you already sent it, you can tidy it up; if not, it is worth sending.
suggestions.rationale: Open item from 2025-10-05 on the MusterStrom Flex contract.

suggestions.title: Compare your electricity tariff
suggestions.body: You pay €48.00 a month (€576.00 a year) for MusterStrom Flex, and the minimum term has ended. A quick comparison might show a cheaper tariff.
suggestions.rationale: MusterStrom Flex is a flexible contract past its minimum term, costing €576.00 a year.
